title: .lichen.tech CA design and operational spec
description: Design the public LICHEN CA service (.lichen.tech). Operational decisions: (1) CA hierarchy: offline root + online intermediate, (2) HSM requirements for root key, (3) CRL/OCSP distribution (CRL in CoAP resource on gateway? OCSP via border router?), (4) cert lifetime (7-30 days per spec, auto-renewable), (5) identity verification integration (Stripe Identity, ID.me per futurism doc), (6) cross-signing policy (who can cross-sign with .lichen.tech, what do they attest to), (7) cost model (free tier for individuals, organizational tier). Output: operational design doc, not implementation. Depends on cert profile being finalized.
